title: ExecutionEnvironment: Interface, types, capabilities, LocalEnvironment
description:
Implement ExecutionEnvironment foundation from docs/plans/11-sandbox-host-service.add01.md.

Required reading: docs/plans/00-implementation-guide.md

Sections: §3 (interface), §4 (capabilities), §5.1 (LocalEnvironment), §3.2 (shared types)

Key deliverables:
- ExecutionEnvironment interface in internal/sandbox/environment/
- Shared types: SessionConfig, SnapshotInfo, SessionState (6 constants), ToolRequest, ToolResponse, ToolProgress
- Error sentinels: ErrCapabilityNotSupported, ErrSessionNotFound, ErrNotActive, ErrProviderUnavailable
- Capabilities struct + static capability constants (Local, NativeSandbox, E2B, Daytona, Fly)
- LocalEnvironment implementation in internal/sandbox/environment/local/:
  - No-op lifecycle (Create/Pause/Resume succeed, Destroy marks destroyed)
  - Direct local tool execution (port from current LocalBackend logic)
  - State tracking with atomic.Bool for destroyed
  - Capabilities() returns LocalCapabilities
- Unit tests for LocalEnvironment (lifecycle, tool execution, destroyed state, capabilities)
- Contract compliance tests that any ExecutionEnvironment must pass

AC: Interface compiles, LocalEnvironment passes contract compliance suite, existing LocalBackend functionality preserved.
